integration_points.details: Electron main.ts spawns trading-runtime shaded JAR on port 8080; Vue renderer calls 70 HTTP REST endpoints (/api/*) and subscribes to /ws/runs/:runId.

integration_points.type: HTTP REST Polling + Kill Switch POST
integration_points.details: Laravel ControlPlaneClient polls /api/health, /api/control/summary, /api/broker-accounts every 5s and posts emergency stops to /api/strategies/{id}/kill.
OandaBroker/OandaExecutor connect to api-fxpractice.oanda.com; IbkrBroker/IbkrLiveRunner connect to IB Gateway on 127.0.0.1:4002 (clientId=11).

integration_points.type: CLI Subprocess + Binary .sqx Parser + HTTPS Webhook Push
integration_points.details: sqx_ctrl.py and extract_sqx_backtest.py manage sqcli and parse dailyEquity.bin; sqx_telemetry_pusher.py, ibkr_pnl_push.py, and ibkr_snapshot_push.py push live telemetry to Hermes Web.
